NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
966 West | 8th Street
From C1-2 to B2-5

The Property
The subject properly is a vacant parcel located in a C1-2, Neighborhood Commercial District.

It is located in an Equitable Transit Served Location approximately 1,400 feet from the Hasted Street METRA
station entrance.

The Project
PL 966 BUYERS LLC (the “Applicant”) proposes to build a five story mixed usc building (57’-2” height) with

1,420 square feet of ground Noor commercial space, 24 units above the ground floor, and seven indoor parking
spaces. 24 bicycle spaces will be added.

The Applicant seeks to rezone the property to allow the proposed improvements and also is filing a Type 1
rezoning application pursuant to Section 17-13-0300 to 1) reduce 12 required parking spaces to seven under
section 17-10-0102-B for properties located in Equitable Transit Served Locations and 2) to reduce the rear yard
setback under section 17-3-0405-A from 30.0’ to 5.0’.

To allow the proposed project, the Applicant seeks a change in zoning classification for the subject property from
aC1-2, Neighborhood Commercial District to a B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 7,128 square feet

FAR: 40

Floor Area: 28,500 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 24

MLA Density: 297 square feet

Height: 57-2”

Bicycle Parking: 24

Automobile Parking: 7

Setbacks: Front (north/1 6th): 0.0°
East: 12.0”
West: 12.0”

Rear (north/alley): 5.0°*

A set of plans is attached.
* As mentioned above, the Applicant sccks optional Variation rclicf under section 17-13-0300 to reduce parking
to seven spaces and to reduce the rear yard setback from 30.0’ to 5.0".
